subject: Important Update: Account Security Measures
body: Dear valued customer, We are reaching out to inform you about recent security updates to our online platform. In an effort to enhance account security, we have implemented two-factor authentication for all users. Your safety and privacy are of utmost importance to us, and we believe these measures will further safeguard your personal information. Please ensure you follow the instructions provided in the email to set up two-factor authentication promptly. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, Security Team
